description: This file contains utility functions for bit counting (popcount) for 32-bit and 64-bit integers, along with license and copyright information.

methods.name: sensord_popcount_32
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits (population count) in a 32-bit unsigned integer using bitwise operations.

methods.name: sensord_popcount_64
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits (population count) in a 64-bit unsigned integer using bitwise operations.
